preconditions.description: The input msg must be a string.
The length of the input string msg must be non-negative.

postconditions.description: If the input string is empty, the output must be an empty string.
The length of the output string must be half the length of the input string, rounded down.

postconditions.expression: all(c in msg for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: All characters in the output string must be present in the input string.
